question_text: A 3-year-old boy is brought to the physician because of a 3-day history of fever and chills. The mother reports that he has also been limping for 2 days. The range of motion of the leg is also limited by pain. While walking, he avoids putting weight on his left leg. Laboratory studies show an erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 67 mm/h. An MRI is most likely to show abnormalities in which of the following regions?
